title: Trump signs order renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America, escalating Canada feud
description: President Donald Trump said he's making the change because “Canada has been ripping us off for a long time on trade, very sadly.”

title: Karoline Leavitt says she’ll miss the press on her last day at White House
description: A replacement press secretary may not be named for a while, advisers suggest.

title: Pirro’s special grand jury probing D.C. schools, city oversight of youth
description: The unusual investigation appears to have a broad scope. Prosecutors have contacted D.C. Public Schools personnel to question them about truancy and graduation rates.

title: New coalition fights Trump’s efforts to weaken protections for historic sites
description: A coalition of preservation groups says the regulatory, legislative and executive efforts pose the greatest threat in 60 years to a law requiring federal agencies to avoid harm to historic sites.

title: We know you care about the environment because you’re sweating
description: A novel study compared the issues survey respondents said were important to their physiological reactions in a lab.

title: World’s nuclear watchdog endorses Trump’s push for Kim Jong Un meeting
description: In an interview with The Washington Post, Rafael Mariano Grossi, one of the world’s most respected arms control experts, backed the case for dialogue.

title: A former Mike Collins staffer posted KKK and Nazi images. Some Republicans see a pattern.
description: Rep. Mike Collins (R-Georgia) is challenging Sen. Jon Ossoff (D). The former Collins staffer posted a swastika and shared an image of himself in what appear to be KKK robes.

title: El-Sayed’s ties to firebrand influencer threaten Democrats’ path to control Senate
description: Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed (D) has close political ties to political commentator Hasan Piker, who has been accused of antisemitism. Piker says his comments against Israel have been misunderstood.

title: One Florida primary exposes Democrats’ dilemma over race, power and the House
description: In their bid to counter GOP redistricting, Democrats debate breaking up Black-held districts.

title: Trump keeps boosting data centers, even as other Republicans grow critical
description: The president is defending the data center boom as GOP officials across the country turn against projects that have angered voters.

title: Trump under pressure at home and abroad as midterms approach
description: President Trump is under pressure internationally and domestically as the year's primary elections near an end.

title: A look at Trump's inner circle and the increased resistance from some of his allies
description: NPR's A Martínez asks Chris Whipple, the Vanity Fair writer who spent time inside the Trump administration, why the president is experiencing increasing resistance to his plans.

title: NDAs are hiding data center deals, drawing ire from locals — and attention from lawmakers
description: Nondisclosure agreements covered up negotiations between a tech company and several local and state officials, surprising local residents. It's a tactic used around the country in data center deals.

title: Jon Ossoff, usually a head down senator, has found a formula to excite Democrats
description: Ossoff should be among the most vulnerable Senate incumbents this year. Instead, the Georgia Democrat has opened a steady lead in polls and is increasingly seen as a potential 2028 contender.

title: Andrew Tate is seeking bail in his extradition fight. Here's why that's unlikely
description: There's a fear that people facing international extradition granted bail could flee. Andrew Tate and his brother face a total of 59 criminal charges in the U.K., including rape and human trafficking.

title: Fired FEMA crew leader defends skipping homes with Trump campaign signs
description: Marni Washington said she was following protocol to keep field workers safe in a politicized environment following 2024’s Hurricane Milton.

title: Judge lifts block on Trump changes to mail voting, though legal fights continue
description: The president’s executive order is now in effect for the midterm elections, but the ruling leaves the door open to renewed challenges from rights groups.

title: Alaska’s weird (and important) Senate race
description: There will be two Dan Sullivans on the ballot, which greatly benefits Democrats.

title: Trump visa restrictions will worsen strains on the economy, experts say
description: Several Trump administration moves to restrict legal immigration, including a pause in visa appointments and the cancellation of tourism and business visas, will harm the economy and workforce, experts say.

title: Case against lawmaker charged in Delaney Hall clash can proceed, appeals court rules
description: Rep. LaMonica McIver (D-New Jersey) has denied the allegations that she assaulted federal agents during a scuffle outside an immigration detention facility last spring.

title: Ex-DOD worker admits trying to trade classified info for foreign citizenship
description: Cybersecurity specialist Nathan Vilas Laatsch, 29, had expressed disagreement with the Trump administration, court records state.

title: The White House's preferred economic tools are hitting snags
description: Tariffs and export controls have been the Trump administration's main economic security tools. Neither is working very well right now.

title: Trump touts power of his endorsement following South Sen. Darline Graham's primary win
description: Darline Graham won her primary runoff in the race to replace her late brother in the US Senate. And President Trump can again tout the power of his endorsement.

title: In Texas Senate race, Talarico seeks depositions that could damage Paxton
description: Democrat James Talarico has leaned into Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton’s past legal scandals to try to win over moderate Republicans.

title: Judge clears the way for Postal Service work on Trump's mail-in voting order for now
description: A federal judge in Boston canceled a nationwide ruling that blocked U.S. Postal Service work on President Trump's order to limit mail-in voting for the midterm election. But a new block may come soon.

title: Democrats target Republicans who voted for SNAP cuts with billboards
description: The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee is rolling out mobile billboards aimed at a handful of GOP lawmakers in swing districts.

title: Before Hegseth fired him, top general was advised to drop Kid Rock probe
description: Gen. Randy George appeared troubled by the encounter with Gen. Chris LaNeve, the Army’s No. 2 officer now favored for the service’s top job, people familiar with the matter told The Post.

title: CIA director’s secretive visit to Moscow stirs mystery
description: A Kremlin spokesman said John Ratcliffe did not meet with Vladimir Putin and that it was "premature" to say whether the trip would affect fraught U.S.-Russia relations.

title: Dan Sullivan joins Dan Sullivan on the November ballot in confusing Alaska race
description: A retired teacher with the same name as the incumbent senator could pose trouble for Republicans in the competitive Senate race.

title: Lawyers gear up as Trump administration threatens election officials with arrest
description: Private voting rights attorneys and Democratic attorneys general are preparing to defend election officials and file lawsuits against the federal government.

title: Takeaways from the latest primaries as Trump reverses a losing streak
description: Victories for Sen. Darline Graham in South Carolina and Mike Mazzei in Oklahoma showed the president’s backing still carries clout.

title: The impact of the trade war between the U.S. and Canada
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Democractic Congresswoman Debbie Dingell of Michigan about the trade war between the U.S. and Canada.

title: Judge issues setback to Trump administration plans to restrict mail-in ballots
description: The ruling is not the final word in a fast-moving legal fight over the administration’s efforts to change voting rules before the midterms.

title: House GOP faces complaint for using floor footage in campaign materials
description: The action targets Rep. Richard Hudson, chair of House Republicans’ campaign arm. Rules bar lawmakers from using recordings of official proceedings for campaigns.

title: What to know about the court fights over voting by mail
description: After the Supreme Court's ruling on Monday, where do things stand in the lawsuits over President Donald Trump's attempt to limit who can cast ballots by mail?

title: Court halts Ohio proof-of-citizenship requirement at motor vehicle offices
description: Ohio’s law requiring proof of citizenship at Bureau of Motor Vehicles’ offices conflicts with the federal National Voter Registration Act, the court said.

title: Trump is having trouble changing how Americans vote
description: Election experts say confusion, rather than actual changes to law, will be the main hindrance to voter participation in November.

title: Wisconsin prosecutor declines to charge Musk in election bribery investigation
description: The tech titan last year had offered voters a chance at a $1 million prize.

title: Sen. Darline Graham wins GOP nomination for U.S. Senate in South Carolina
description: In a major win for President Trump who went all in for the political newcomer, Sen. Darline Graham beat out longtime Congressman Ralph Norman in a special election primary runoff in South Carolina.
